evidence: Implements an in-tree test framework in src/test/util/framework.h (+1209 lines) and transitions the entire unit test suite away from Boost.Test.
rationale: Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree framework that provides expression decomposition and enables custom runner customization. Josibake notes this allows customizing test runner behavior to Core's needs, unblocking concurrency improvements and removing barriers to writing tests.
